faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar is 14th September 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree or a Bachelor's degree in computer science and engineering or related fields with a valid GATE score. Additionally, a minimum of 60% in graduation and above, and 55% in 10th and 12th are required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Gandhinagar Junior Research Fellow recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to submit their applications through the official portal.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by a selection test.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Gandhinagar is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Gandhinagar located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information regarding the recruitment.
